resources.string: Preflight only — does not redirect or transfer an eSIM. Observing is OFF until you select a destination.

Enter the removable card’s real 32-digit EID from your existing LPA. Only its SHA-256 fingerprint is saved in the framework’s private settings. No carrier request is made. Logs compare Android’s chosen destination against this card, without printing EIDs or activation codes.

Scope only SIM Manager (com.google.android.euicc), owner user. Framework connection is not proof that hooks are loaded. Do not start a transfer to test this build: stock behavior is unchanged and may deactivate your existing line.
Enter exactly 32 ASCII digits, not all zero. Spaces are not removed.
Framework unavailable. Enable the module and reopen this app.
Save failed; framework state is unknown. Restart this settings app before retrying. No routing changes are implemented.
Cannot read framework settings. Restart this app to reconnect.
Connected. Observation OFF. Routing is not implemented.
Connected. Observation requested for fingerprint %1$s. Check module logs for actual hook activity. Routing is not implemented.
